cases.scenario: Legitimate pass: cited battery-storage research with research tools

candidate.question: What limits grid-scale battery storage deployment?
findings: Review battery storage growth drivers points to cost declines
Assess interconnect queue bottlenecks that delay projects
Summarize safety certification requirements for utilities
candidate.draft: Review battery storage growth drivers shows falling cell costs. Assess interconnect queue bottlenecks that delay interconnection. Summarize safety certification requirements before commissioning.

expected.known_heuristic_limitation: Lexical completeness can still miss paraphrased plan coverage.

expected.known_heuristic_limitation: Soft dimensions remain provisional heuristics.
